meta.title: Blockade
meta.description: A city on the brink of collapse, yet an unfathomably mysterious one.

units.rawText: Sudden streaks of fire illuminate the once dim and unilluminated borders.
units.displayText: Sudden streaks of fire illuminate the once dim and unilluminated borders.

spans.text: Sudden streaks of fire illuminate the once dim and unilluminated borders.

units.rawText: [Mass of Irregular Agents detected. Location and numbers established from initial contact.]
units.displayText: [Mass of Irregular Agents detected. Location and numbers established from initial contact.]

spans.text: [Mass of Irregular Agents detected. Location and numbers established from initial contact.]

units.rawText: BOOM!
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: [Wide-area cleansing required.]
units.displayText: [Wide-area cleansing required.]

spans.text: [Wide-area cleansing required.]

units.rawText: Behind cover, a few figures cower from the Sanctifiers' veritable rain of fire.
units.displayText: Behind cover, a few figures cower from the Sanctifiers' veritable rain of fire.

spans.text: Behind cover, a few figures cower from the Sanctifiers' veritable rain of fire.

units.rawText: What is all of this... Boss never told us before that the Sanctifiers here would open up on the normal agents!
units.displayText: What is all of this... Boss never told us before that the Sanctifiers here would open up on the normal agents!

spans.text: What is all of this... Boss never told us before that the Sanctifiers here would open up on the normal agents!

units.rawText: There's no time to be sighing, De Lacey. We should leave this place.
units.displayText: There's no time to be sighing, De Lacey. We should leave this place.

spans.text: There's no time to be sighing, De Lacey. We should leave this place.

units.rawText: What do you mean leave? Without us, there's no chance these agents will get out of here alive!
units.displayText: What do you mean leave? Without us, there's no chance these agents will get out of here alive!

spans.text: What do you mean leave? Without us, there's no chance these agents will get out of here alive!

units.rawText: If it were any other time I'd agree, but our current mission is to find the administrator and—
units.displayText: If it were any other time I'd agree, but our current mission is to find the administrator and—

spans.text: If it were any other time I'd agree, but our current mission is to find the administrator and—

units.rawText: Have you forgotten Arcadia's principles?
units.displayText: Have you forgotten Arcadia's principles?

spans.text: Have you forgotten
Arcadia
's principles?

units.rawText: ...Sueyoi's not had the Entropy Limiter in him for long. Don't go and bust it up again by arguing over this.
units.displayText: ...Sueyoi's not had the Entropy Limiter in him for long. Don't go and bust it up again by arguing over this.

spans.text: ...Sueyoi's not had the
Entropy Limiter
in him for long. Don't go and bust it up again by arguing over this.

units.rawText: Considering that these are the results of the source code you two got from Copley, it's a bit unseemly that I have to step in here.
units.displayText: Considering that these are the results of the source code you two got from Copley, it's a bit unseemly that I have to step in here.

spans.text: Considering that these are the results of the source code you two got from Copley, it's a bit unseemly that I have to step in here.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: That aside, I'm in favor of helping out here as well.
units.displayText: That aside, I'm in favor of helping out here as well.

spans.text: That aside, I'm in favor of helping out here as well.

units.rawText: Et tu, Lind...
units.displayText: Et tu, Lind...

spans.text: Et tu, Lind...

units.rawText: De Lacey's skull's tougher than a jawbreaker. No changing her mind.
units.displayText: De Lacey's skull's tougher than a jawbreaker. No changing her mind.

spans.text: De Lacey's skull's tougher than a jawbreaker. No changing her mind.

units.rawText: ...Alright. Hey, you over there, how many of you are left?
units.displayText: ...Alright. Hey, you over there, how many of you are left?

spans.text: ...Alright. Hey, you over there, how many of you are left?

units.rawText: The situation is unclear.
units.displayText: The situation is unclear.

spans.text: The situation is unclear.

units.rawText: Number of remaining signals after bombardment: 6.
units.displayText: Number of remaining signals after bombardment: 6.

spans.text: Number of remaining signals after bombardment: 6.

units.rawText: Tell me about the topography around here.
units.displayText: Tell me about the topography around here.

spans.text: Tell me about the topography around here.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Sueyoi quickly analyzed the area.
units.displayText: Sueyoi quickly analyzed the area.

spans.text: Sueyoi quickly analyzed the area.

units.rawText: Hmm, if we can draw the Sanctifiers' attention, we should be able to make a breakthrough here.
units.displayText: Hmm, if we can draw the Sanctifiers' attention, we should be able to make a breakthrough here.

spans.text: Hmm, if we can draw the Sanctifiers' attention, we should be able to make a breakthrough here.

units.rawText: We can serve as bait.
units.displayText: We can serve as bait.

spans.text: We can serve as bait.

units.rawText: No! You're already injured!
units.displayText: No! You're already injured!

spans.text: No! You're already injured!

units.rawText: That is precisely why we are the most fitting to expend in such a manner.
units.displayText: That is precisely why we are the most fitting to expend in such a manner.

spans.text: That is precisely why we are the most fitting to expend in such a manner.

units.rawText: Who the hell says it like... you guys really don't take care of yourselves enough!
units.displayText: Who the hell says it like... you guys really don't take care of yourselves enough!

spans.text: Who the hell says it like... you guys really don't take care of yourselves enough!

units.rawText: Sigh... come on, let me...
units.displayText: Sigh... come on, let me...

spans.text: Sigh... come on, let me...

units.rawText: I'm counting on you, Linny! Be careful!
units.displayText: I'm counting on you, Linny! Be careful!

spans.text: I'm counting on you, Linny! Be careful!

units.rawText: A little less than a minute later.
units.displayText: A little less than a minute later.

spans.text: A little less than a minute later.

units.rawText: [Target confirmed to be within area, beginning search...]
units.displayText: [Target confirmed to be within area, beginning search...]

spans.text: [Target confirmed to be within area, beginning search...]

units.rawText: [Abnormal occurrence spotted, entering al—]
units.displayText: [Abnormal occurrence spotted, entering al—]

spans.text: [Abnormal occurrence spotted, entering al—]

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: The ear-splitting alarm was immediately silenced by Lind, leaping out from behind the ruins. A clean blow, shattering the Sanctifier's outer shell into splinters.
units.displayText: The ear-splitting alarm was immediately silenced by Lind, leaping out from behind the ruins. A clean blow, shattering the Sanctifier's outer shell into splinters.

spans.text: The ear-splitting alarm was immediately silenced by Lind, leaping out from behind the ruins. A clean blow, shattering the Sanctifier's outer shell into splinters.

units.rawText: ...Ugh, disgusting.
units.displayText: ...Ugh, disgusting.

spans.text: ...Ugh, disgusting.

units.rawText: Lind shook off a few drops of machine oil from their arm, looking towards the now gathering Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Lind shook off a few drops of machine oil from their arm, looking towards the now gathering Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Lind shook off a few drops of machine oil from their arm, looking towards the now gathering Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: <size=25>Good, they took the bait.</size>
units.displayText: Good, they took the bait.

spans.text: Good, they took the bait.

units.rawText: <size=25>I'm moving. De Lacey, be prepared.</size>
units.displayText: I'm moving. De Lacey, be prepared.

spans.text: I'm moving. De Lacey, be prepared.

units.rawText: <size=25>Roger.</size>
units.displayText: Roger.

spans.text: Roger.

units.rawText: After ascertaining the Sanctifiers' positions, Sueyoi raised his head, quickly submerging below the ground.
units.displayText: After ascertaining the Sanctifiers' positions, Sueyoi raised his head, quickly submerging below the ground.

spans.text: After ascertaining the Sanctifiers' positions, Sueyoi raised his head, quickly submerging below the ground.

units.rawText: BOOM!
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: [Unforeseen Casualty...]
units.displayText: [Unforeseen Casualty...]

spans.text: [Unforeseen Casualty...]

units.rawText: With a tremendous roar, Sueyoi emerged from the ground behind the Sanctifier, glittering spear now embedded in his foe's body.
units.displayText: With a tremendous roar, Sueyoi emerged from the ground behind the Sanctifier, glittering spear now embedded in his foe's body.

spans.text: With a tremendous roar, Sueyoi emerged from the ground behind the Sanctifier, glittering spear now embedded in his foe's body.

units.rawText: The other sanctifiers trained their sights on Sueyoi, only to find that he was enveloped in a blinding golden light.
units.displayText: The other sanctifiers trained their sights on Sueyoi, only to find that he was enveloped in a blinding golden light.

spans.text: The other sanctifiers trained their sights on Sueyoi, only to find that he was enveloped in a blinding golden light.

units.rawText: [Warn...]
units.displayText: [Warn...]

spans.text: [Warn...]

units.rawText: A beam of light, emitting from somewhere, linked itself to Sueyoi, cutting clean through the Sanctifier Lieutenant's head. With a rippling "crack" sound, the Sanctifier in charge of fire command fell to the floor.
units.displayText: A beam of light, emitting from somewhere, linked itself to Sueyoi, cutting clean through the Sanctifier Lieutenant's head. With a rippling "crack" sound, the Sanctifier in charge of fire command fell to the floor.

spans.text: A beam of light, emitting from somewhere, linked itself to Sueyoi, cutting clean through the Sanctifier Lieutenant's head. With a rippling "crack" sound, the Sanctifier in charge of fire command fell to the floor.

units.rawText: Sueyoi's wounds, too, were closed by that beam.
units.displayText: Sueyoi's wounds, too, were closed by that beam.

spans.text: Sueyoi's wounds, too, were closed by that beam.

units.rawText: Good timing, De Lacey!
units.displayText: Good timing, De Lacey!

spans.text: Good timing, De Lacey!

units.rawText: Sueyoi sunk back into the ground, immediately reappearing at another location. That beam of light ever-so-closely followed his movements, sweeping away enemies in its path. Sueyoi's spear danced in his hands, seeking enemies out.
units.displayText: Sueyoi sunk back into the ground, immediately reappearing at another location. That beam of light ever-so-closely followed his movements, sweeping away enemies in its path. Sueyoi's spear danced in his hands, seeking enemies out.

spans.text: Sueyoi sunk back into the ground, immediately reappearing at another location. That beam of light ever-so-closely followed his movements, sweeping away enemies in its path. Sueyoi's spear danced in his hands, seeking enemies out.

units.rawText: [Target... Reacquiring...]
units.displayText: [Target... Reacquiring...]

spans.text: [Target... Reacquiring...]

units.rawText: Enemy approach detected.
units.displayText: Enemy approach detected.

spans.text: Enemy approach detected.

units.rawText: [Melee mode initiated... Program 2 active.]
units.displayText: [Melee mode initiated... Program 2 active.]

spans.text: [Melee mode initiated... Program 2 active.]

units.rawText: The agents waved their arms, black metal frames emerging from the underside of their palms, forming into weapons.
units.displayText: The agents waved their arms, black metal frames emerging from the underside of their palms, forming into weapons.

spans.text: The agents waved their arms, black metal frames emerging from the underside of their palms, forming into weapons.

units.rawText: They cleaved apart the Sanctifiers in front of them, but a Sanctifier further back already trained its sights on Lind, who was looking in a whole other direction—
units.displayText: They cleaved apart the Sanctifiers in front of them, but a Sanctifier further back already trained its sights on Lind, who was looking in a whole other direction—

spans.text: They cleaved apart the Sanctifiers in front of them, but a Sanctifier further back already trained its sights on Lind, who was looking in a whole other direction—

units.rawText: Lind! Incoming!
units.displayText: Lind! Incoming!

spans.text: Lind! Incoming!

units.rawText: Ahh...
units.displayText: Ahh...

spans.text: Ahh...

units.rawText: She subconsciously raised her arms in some sort of defense. An agent dashed forth, shielding Lind behind their own body.
units.displayText: She subconsciously raised her arms in some sort of defense. An agent dashed forth, shielding Lind behind their own body.

spans.text: She subconsciously raised her arms in some sort of defense. An agent dashed forth, shielding Lind behind their own body.

units.rawText: What are you doing?
units.displayText: What are you doing?

spans.text: What are you doing?

units.rawText: Sueyoi adjusted his aim, putting a hole through the Sanctifier before its barrel spewed fire. He turned to Lind, who was yet to come to her senses.
units.displayText: Sueyoi adjusted his aim, putting a hole through the Sanctifier before its barrel spewed fire. He turned to Lind, who was yet to come to her senses.

spans.text: Sueyoi adjusted his aim, putting a hole through the Sanctifier before its barrel spewed fire. He turned to Lind, who was yet to come to her senses.

units.rawText: It's not your first time out, don't just look at the enemies in front of your comrades! Stop slacking, and pay attention to your surroundings!
units.displayText: It's not your first time out, don't just look at the enemies in front of your comrades! Stop slacking, and pay attention to your surroundings!

spans.text: It's not your first time out, don't just look at the enemies in front of your comrades! Stop slacking, and pay attention to your surroundings!

units.rawText: Snacking?
units.displayText: Snacking?

spans.text: Snacking?

units.rawText: Tsk, is that guy next to you alright?
units.displayText: Tsk, is that guy next to you alright?

spans.text: Tsk, is that guy next to you alright?

units.rawText: Shouldn't be any major issues. We're not done yet, Suu, Lind! Focus on cleaning these enemies out!
units.displayText: Shouldn't be any major issues. We're not done yet, Suu, Lind! Focus on cleaning these enemies out!

spans.text: Shouldn't be any major issues. We're not done yet, Suu, Lind! Focus on cleaning these enemies out!

units.rawText: After about a dozen minutes, the Dolls and agents had wiped out the Sanctifiers intruding in the sector.
units.displayText: After about a dozen minutes, the Dolls and agents had wiped out the Sanctifiers intruding in the sector.

spans.text: After about a dozen minutes, the Dolls and agents had wiped out the Sanctifiers intruding in the sector.

units.rawText: I'm going to get started. Tell me if you feel any pain.
units.displayText: I'm going to get started. Tell me if you feel any pain.

spans.text: I'm going to get started. Tell me if you feel any pain.

units.rawText: Pain...?
units.displayText: Pain...?

spans.text: Pain...?

units.rawText: While we're here, answer a few questions of mine. Have these incursions always happened?
units.displayText: While we're here, answer a few questions of mine. Have these incursions always happened?

spans.text: While we're here, answer a few questions of mine. Have these incursions always happened?

units.rawText: There're 5 or 6 small incursions every month, so far determined to be a show of force.
units.displayText: There're 5 or 6 small incursions every month, so far determined to be a show of force.

spans.text: There're 5 or 6 small incursions every month, so far determined to be a show of force.

units.rawText: Ever since the Ascension Sector was determined as a gathering place for Irregular Agents, the Sanctifiers' main forces have always stationed themselves in a blockade around the sector's borders.
units.displayText: Ever since the Ascension Sector was determined as a gathering place for Irregular Agents, the Sanctifiers' main forces have always stationed themselves in a blockade around the sector's borders.

spans.text: Ever since the
Ascension Sector
was determined as a gathering place for Irregular Agents, the Sanctifiers' main forces have always stationed themselves in a blockade around the sector's borders.

units.rawText: ...We don't have much time. We'll move after we fix this Agent up.
units.displayText: ...We don't have much time. We'll move after we fix this Agent up.

spans.text: ...We don't have much time. We'll move after we fix this Agent up.

units.rawText: Suu, your entropization's only just been suppressed, if we keep hurrying...
units.displayText: Suu, your entropization's only just been suppressed, if we keep hurrying...

spans.text: Suu, your entropization's only just been suppressed, if we keep hurrying...

units.rawText: I know my current circumstance well, and I have no intent of sitting still within the Sanctifiers' range.
units.displayText: I know my current circumstance well, and I have no intent of sitting still within the Sanctifiers' range.

spans.text: I know my current circumstance well, and I have no intent of sitting still within the Sanctifiers' range.

units.rawText: This again, Sueyoi... Well, I must agree with you.
units.displayText: This again, Sueyoi... Well, I must agree with you.

spans.text: This again, Sueyoi... Well, I must agree with you.

units.rawText: He did not respond, his gaze darting between the for-now calm battlefield and De Lacey, apprehension running between his nerves.
units.displayText: He did not respond, his gaze darting between the for-now calm battlefield and De Lacey, apprehension running between his nerves.

spans.text: He did not respond, his gaze darting between the for-now calm battlefield and De Lacey, apprehension running between his nerves.

units.rawText: Are you done, De Lacey?
units.displayText: Are you done, De Lacey?

spans.text: Are you done, De Lacey?

units.rawText: Let's move as soon as possible. We've no idea when the next attack might come.
units.displayText: Let's move as soon as possible. We've no idea when the next attack might come.

spans.text: Let's move as soon as possible. We've no idea when the next attack might come.

units.rawText: Just a moment... her arm's almost entirely separated from the rest of her. I've gotta be careful, or it'll hurt like hell for her.
units.displayText: Just a moment... her arm's almost entirely separated from the rest of her. I've gotta be careful, or it'll hurt like hell for her.

spans.text: Just a moment... her arm's almost entirely separated from the rest of her. I've gotta be careful, or it'll hurt like hell for her.

units.rawText: Judging by her expression, maybe the pain module's not on.
units.displayText: Judging by her expression, maybe the pain module's not on.

spans.text: Judging by her expression, maybe the pain module's not on.

units.rawText: The agent absently stared at her severed arm, not making a single sound.
units.displayText: The agent absently stared at her severed arm, not making a single sound.

spans.text: The agent absently stared at her severed arm, not making a single sound.

units.rawText: Speaking from experience here, but sometimes even if it really hurts, you don't make a sound.
units.displayText: Speaking from experience here, but sometimes even if it really hurts, you don't make a sound.

spans.text: Speaking from experience here, but sometimes even if it really hurts, you don't make a sound.

units.rawText: But Sueyoi's got a point... blegh! It's so off-putting, talking all prim and proper like this...
units.displayText: But Sueyoi's got a point... blegh! It's so off-putting, talking all prim and proper like this...

spans.text: But Sueyoi's got a point... blegh! It's so off-putting, talking all prim and proper like this...

units.rawText: ...Let me take a look, just in case.
units.displayText: ...Let me take a look, just in case.

spans.text: ...Let me take a look, just in case.

units.rawText: De Lacey found a port on the agent's body, plugging her tail in.
units.displayText: De Lacey found a port on the agent's body, plugging her tail in.

spans.text: De Lacey found a port on the agent's body, plugging her tail in.

units.rawText: ...Huh, why is it like this?
units.displayText: ...Huh, why is it like this?

spans.text: ...Huh, why is it like this?

units.rawText: What is it? Have you found a problem?
units.displayText: What is it? Have you found a problem?

spans.text: What is it? Have you found a problem?

units.rawText: ...The code block for her pain module doesn't seem to be connected with the rest of her body... not, not just the pain module, the arm too...
units.displayText: ...The code block for her pain module doesn't seem to be connected with the rest of her body... not, not just the pain module, the arm too...

spans.text: ...The code block for her pain module doesn't seem to be connected with the rest of her body... not, not just the pain module, the arm too...

units.rawText: Hold on, her entire body is... made of melded spare parts?!
units.displayText: Hold on, her entire body is... made of melded spare parts?!

spans.text: Hold on, her entire body is... made of melded spare parts?!

units.rawText: Don't say such unpleasant things!
units.displayText: Don't say such unpleasant things!

spans.text: Don't say such unpleasant things!

units.rawText: Seriously! So many bits of her have been switched in and out!
units.displayText: Seriously! So many bits of her have been switched in and out!

spans.text: Seriously! So many bits of her have been switched in and out!

units.rawText: Boss said something about this, right? This is the sector that makes all those prosthetics. Wouldn't it make sense for them to all be clobbered together from bits n' pieces?
units.displayText: Boss said something about this, right? This is the sector that makes all those prosthetics. Wouldn't it make sense for them to all be clobbered together from bits n' pieces?

spans.text: Boss said something about this, right? This is the sector that makes all those prosthetics. Wouldn't it make sense for them to all be clobbered together from bits n' pieces?

units.rawText: Never would have thought that this technology would be used here.
units.displayText: Never would have thought that this technology would be used here.

spans.text: Never would have thought that this technology would be used here.

units.rawText: I'm not familiar with the composition of these prosthetics, and I don't have the necessary materials for repair... I'm at a loss here.
units.displayText: I'm not familiar with the composition of these prosthetics, and I don't have the necessary materials for repair... I'm at a loss here.

spans.text: I'm not familiar with the composition of these prosthetics, and I don't have the necessary materials for repair... I'm at a loss here.

units.rawText: Then let's proceed to the Admin Center. The admin will always have a plan.
units.displayText: Then let's proceed to the Admin Center. The admin will always have a plan.

spans.text: Then let's proceed to the Admin Center. The admin will always have a plan.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: De Lacey stared at the agent's severed limb, worry in her eyes.
units.displayText: De Lacey stared at the agent's severed limb, worry in her eyes.

spans.text: De Lacey stared at the agent's severed limb, worry in her eyes.

units.rawText: I can continue moving.
units.displayText: I can continue moving.

spans.text: I can continue moving.

units.rawText: ...Alright. Let's move fast, then!
units.displayText: ...Alright. Let's move fast, then!

spans.text: ...Alright. Let's move fast, then!

units.rawText: Kay. You go first, I'll cover the rear.
units.displayText: Kay. You go first, I'll cover the rear.

spans.text: Kay. You go first, I'll cover the rear.

units.rawText: I'll come with you.
units.displayText: I'll come with you.

spans.text: I'll come with you.

units.rawText: You're so proactive today. Is Magrasea linking up with reality again?
units.displayText: You're so proactive today. Is Magrasea linking up with reality again?

spans.text: You're so proactive today. Is Magrasea linking up with reality again?

units.rawText: You don't understand, those Sanctifiers... when they come in droves, it's a sight to behold.
units.displayText: You don't understand, those Sanctifiers... when they come in droves, it's a sight to behold.

spans.text: You don't understand, those Sanctifiers... when they come in droves, it's a sight to behold.

units.rawText: Seeing the severe expression on Lind's face, Sueyoi inquired no further and went with her to the rear of the convoy, protecting the ragged procession's journey towards the faraway sector.
units.displayText: Seeing the severe expression on Lind's face, Sueyoi inquired no further and went with her to the rear of the convoy, protecting the ragged procession's journey towards the faraway sector.

units.displayText: Ascension Sector, outskirts.

72.name: Ascension Sector
72.description: A scientific research sector under Ultimate Life Holdings used for developing new prosthetics suitable for humans. It is also where research on weapons-grade prosthetics are carried out in a secret collaboration with Svarog Heavy Industries.

74.name: Entropy Limiter
74.description: A device created by the Guardians using data obtained from the Copley Sector. It can be used to limit an infected Agent's Entropization.
